title.narrative: Acceleration towards achieving zero Indigenous Malaria in Bhutan - Bhutan (01-Jul-2015-30-Jun-2018)

description.narrative: Bhutan, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Royal Government of Bhutan (MOH)This program has the following goals: To achieve zero indigenous malaria in Bhutan by 2018 and obtain WHO-malaria free certification by 2020.. The objectives of this program are: Objective: Focused prevention, elimination of transmission and prevent re-introduction. Objective: Intensified surveillance and response. Objective: Quality assured laboratory diagnosis, treatment and follow up. Objective: Strengthened Governance and institutional capacities
